items.difficulty_reason: Full execution: the <= direction from the in-pool accepted closed-immersions; the >= direction takes a smooth cover, forms the closure of the image of each component (irreducible-component status carried by the in-pool accepted map-of-components), expands dim via the spaces-level formula (external-carried, named-pointer rank), chooses a component attaining the supremum, expands dim_x(T) likewise, and closes on the evident fibre inequality dim_u T_x <= dim_u U_x with the closed-subspace justification written in the span.
